Next Geo Named in Global Top 100 Geospatial Companies – 2026 Edition

2026-07-27 AVMDergi Next Geo, Geoawesome, geospatial companies, location analytics, GeoAI, Turkey, Mapbox, HERE Technologies, Google, spatial intelligence
Read the source article

Quick summary

Turkish location analytics company Next Geo has been named the only Turkish firm in Geoawesome's "Global Top 100 Geospatial Companies – 2026 Edition," alongside industry giants like Google, Mapbox, and HERE Technologies.

Key takeaways

  • Next Geo is the only Turkish company selected for the "Global Top 100 Geospatial Companies – 2026 Edition" list curated by Geoawesome
  • The list was created with community participation, with candidates evaluated and voted on by geospatial industry professionals
  • Next Geo specializes in location analytics, investment site selection, target audience analysis, sales forecasting, and AI-powered decision systems
  • The company's GeoAI solutions combine demographic data, consumer profiles, commercial density, and mobility data to produce measurable business insights
  • Next Geo plans to expand into Middle East and European markets, leveraging its scalable software infrastructure and AI-driven decision models
